description: Land Acquisition - Olaithoduvai, Mannar Town D/S Division, Mannar District - Pesalai west, Mannar Town D/S Division, Mannar District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and the legal process for taking possession of these lands. While it mentions a government minister (Harin Fernando) and his title, the core content is exclusively about land acquisition procedures and property descriptions, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
